themes.name: DCF Architecture And Consistency
themes.thesis: Discounted cash flow valuation is built as an internally consistent architecture of cash flows, discount rates, currency, inflation, growth, reinvestment, and terminal value.

themes.name: Risk And Discount Rates
themes.thesis: Risk enters valuation through riskfree rates, equity risk premiums, country risk, betas, costs of debt, and costs of capital that must match the cash flows being valued.

Session 7: Measuring Relative Risk - Betas and Alternatives

themes.name: Growth, Cash Flows, And Operating Reality
themes.thesis: Growth creates value only when the operating story supports margins, taxes, reinvestment, capital intensity, and ownership of future cash flows.
session_titles: Session 11: More on Growth and Terminal Value
Session 10: Estimating Growth
Session 9: Digging Deeper into Cash Flows

themes.name: Pricing As A Different Market Language
themes.thesis: Pricing is treated as a relative and social market language built from multiples, comparables, peer groups, and market mood rather than a shortcut version of intrinsic value.
session_titles: Session 21 (UG) and Session 19 (MBA): Pricing Analytics and Peer Groups
Session 17: Pricing 101

themes.name: Special Situations And Ownership Frictions
themes.thesis: Private companies, IPOs, asset-based cases, distressed firms, and acquisitions reveal where public-market valuation habits need new anchors.

themes.name: Optionality, Control, And Decision Rights
themes.thesis: Late-course material shows when uncertainty can create option value and when control creates value by changing decisions rather than merely changing ownership labels.
